description: OOS rank-IC gate metric. A closed JSON-pointer projection that reads the out-of-sample rank information coefficient at /rank_ic from a FactorICReport@1 or MinedFactorDraft@1 metrics artifact, applicable only when /oos == true (the passed-gate, out-of-sample regime). There is NO expression language: the projection is exactly one absolute JSON pointer for the value plus a closed list of pointer==literal applicability conditions. When a condition pointer is absent or its value does not equal the literal, the metric is 'unavailable' for that artifact and the GateCfg.unavailable_policy (fail/degrade/skip) governs the downstream disposition.
notes: This is the one reviewed kind=gate_metric material Phase 8 ships. Do not add an expression language; a new projection is a new metric_version.
